look_here_first: Think tiny yellow-to-purple Dalea: a very low perennial with silky compound leaves and ovoid flower spikes whose yellow flowers age rose-purple.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Master Plant Pool Hays-local source. Williamson — NPSOT Williamson County rescue seed stock. Llano — historical herbarium specimens collected northwest/west of Valley Spring, which is in Llano County.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Exact county evidence only; locality-to-county mapping used only for named Valley Spring specimens.

best_field_traits: very low perennial from taproot and slightly woody base
dense ovoid to oblong flower spikes
flowers yellow when fresh, aging rose to blue-purple
dry bare limestone, caliche, sandy or stony soils
morphology_keys.comparison_training: D. nana is the low yellow-then-purple member of the set. D. multiflora has white rounded heads; D. tenuis has pink-purple globes and extremely narrow, feathery linear leaflets.
